schema.title: template.presence
schema.description: the entity has a condition over the knobs: while the condition's value is below one, the entity and everything it would make are left out of the site
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from Agent Studio's 05-template-workflow.md section 3.2 (notes/agent-studio-2026-10-17/design/specs/05-template-workflow.md). Open to fields a newer writer adds (SPEC section 9).

when.description: The entity is present when this is one or more. On a placement it governs every instance; in a record's `components` it governs the record and is stripped before the record is written.

expression.title: knob expression
expression.description: An integer expression over the template's knobs: integers, knob keys, + - * / (floor division), min and max, parentheses, separated by spaces (05-template-workflow.md section 3.3). The schema holds its alphabet and its 512-character limit; the template evaluation engine parses it and refuses a name that is not a declared knob.
